name: Practical Course Software Engineering for Business Information Systems
description: The students develop an innovative Web Application of medium complexity in small groups. They do this using a state-of-the-art technology stack for the realization of the business logic, the presentation, and the persistent data storage. All phases of the software development process (including requirements analysis) are covered by the project. While each student team has an advisor, the students are responsible for the project and quality management. Regularly presenting the state and progress is part of the project.
prerequisites:
Prior experience with web technologies is highly recommended. 
Additionally: Module IN0006; Module IN0008; Module IN2085; Module IN2088 (would be advantageous)
